notes.title: NEW GAME ANNOUNCED
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37726056/f504978811a768d126d17c6977f4d83f2146c6fd.png

NEW GAME ANNOUNCED

From the creators of Red Ronin, Undergrave is a Turn-Based roguelike with a deep combat system setted in a dark fantasy world. Use and combine your abilities, manage your stamina and make the ultimate sacrifice to bring your loved one back.

If you liked Red Ronin's puzzles with multiple solutions and [strike]dashing through enemies[/strike], well, this game is for you!


KEY FEATURES

Your character have 3 distinct abilities, each one being necessary for a successful run, however every one of them consume your stamina that recovers with turns so use them wisely.


--  DASH   --

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37726056/3d361bf2037cdde04d626bbacc8f4ab8675c0263.gif


Cut throught the enemies in a straight line dealing damage on them if you have your sword or dodging throught them if you have no sword

--  JUMP  --

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37726056/2b01a20934093fd6a7b1311620af47c347f9c1ba.gif

Jump from a square to another, dealing stun effect on the enemies around if you have your sword or only pushing them if you have no sword.

--  THROW  --

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37726056/6a58260c7f6511bb292ecf88c51c2608e2c103d5.gif

Throw your sword on an enemy dealing damage. The movements cost less Stamina when you are unarmed. You can catch your sword back mid dash or on a jump killing some enemies using less Stamina.

-- PERFECT YOUR STRATEGY --

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37726056/cd8853d36f08e4f49653ff6b170d7b00a84dbb8d.gif

Combine your abilities to oversmart the enemies and find the best move for every turn.

Add it to your wishlist and get notified on launch day!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1776930/Undergrave/

notes.content:
Fixes in this update:

notes.title: Update - Steam Game Festival Autumn Edition
notes.content:
Update - Steam Game Festival Autumn Edition

Hi everyone!

First off: HUUGE thanks to everyone who played the Red Ronin demo. We were very happy with your feedback and thanks to that we changed some things in the game.

For the autumn edition of the Steam Game Festival we brought some improvements to the first stage of the game.


- Isaac can now be controlled with WASD (mouse is now an optional/ tutorial in development), or D-Pad.
- New combo bar design. (The old one was kinda of ugly tbh)
- New menu design.
- New death animations for enemies.
- Button icons now adaptative for PS4 and Switch controls.
- New text font for dialogs.
- Small polishment on character's portraits.
- Small bugfixes (visual stuff, object depth issues, performance issues)

If you haven’t already, please hit the widget below and add Red Ronin to your Wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1222570/


Until next time! 

- Thiago Oliveira
